h1: Custom Wood Headphones for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom wood headphones with your logo. Natural finish, bulk pricing. Perfect for eco-conscious branding.
introHtml: Custom wood headphones bring a natural, premium feel to your branded merchandise that plastic simply cannot match. The warm grain and solid construction make them a favorite for trade shows, corporate gifts, and retail displays. Choose laser engraving for a crisp logo that stands out against the wood surface. These headphones deliver both style and function, appealing to recipients who appreciate sustainable materials and quality audio.
heroAltText: Custom wood headphones with engraved logo, natural wood finish, over-ear style
